text:
This handmade ceramic mug is made for your daily coffee, tea, or cocoa, and it's just as lovely to give to someone else. Because it's handmade, it has a personal touch that a mass-produced mug can't offer, which makes it a thoughtful gift for birthdays, housewarmings, or any day you want to say thank you.

Care is simple: this mug is dishwasher safe, so cleanup is easy. It is not microwave safe, so please heat your drink another way and pour it in once it's ready.
sent:
I'm a seller on Etsy listing a handmade ceramic mug, and I need the description text for the listing. Shoppers skim, so it should be short, warm, and easy to read.

Write the description as exactly two short paragraphs of plain prose, with no headings, bullets, or title. The first paragraph introduces the mug as handmade and ceramic and says what makes it appealing to use or give as a gift. The second paragraph covers care: it is dishwasher safe and not microwave safe. State both plainly so buyers aren't surprised.

The only facts I'm giving you are that the mug is handmade, ceramic, dishwasher safe, and not microwave safe. Don't invent anything else, because buyers will rely on the listing and a wrong detail means returns. That includes the glaze, clay type, color, size, capacity, weight, design, and my process. Keep the appeal general enough that it doesn't depend on a detail I haven't given you.

Reply with only the two paragraphs, ready to paste into Etsy, and nothing before or after them.
